source: Original embedded Crimson Cathedral stage, extracted without modification as original.webp
background: Edit target: the provided NIGHTBLOOM Crimson Cathedral game stage. Produce a clean BACKGROUND PLATE for a subtle 2D fighting game parallax separation. Keep the exact original 16:9 wide composition, original canvas alignment, richly detailed gothic pixel-art rendering, red moon, distant central cathedral silhouette, purple crimson sky, tall side cathedral arches, stained glass, banners and upper side walls. Remove ONLY the two near gargoyle statues with their square pedestals on the lower left and lower right, the stone balustrades across the lower middle, and the closest bottom-edge roses, brambles and large candles. Reconstruct the hidden cathedral wall, distant ruins and floor seamlessly behind these removed objects. Keep the original open polished stone fighting floor, its perspective and gold circular floor pattern at exactly the same screen position. No characters, no text, no new props. Fill all removed regions, NO transparency. Keep all other original pixels/style/composition as close as possible. Output a single full-frame 16:9 landscape background plate.
middle: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is the supplied Crimson Cathedral stage. Extract ONLY the two carved stone gargoyle statues on their pedestal bases (left and right), plus the low broken stone balustrade railing stretching across the lower middle behind the fighting floor, and the candles/roses attached to these pedestal/railing objects. Return these objects as a SINGLE genuinely transparent PNG parallax MIDDLE LAYER, preserving their original screen positions and scale on the SAME full-frame 16:9 canvas as the source. Pixel-perfect placement as close as possible: left statue/pedestal occupies x=2%-20%, y=18%-69%; right statue/pedestal x=76%-96%,y=21%-69%; balustrades x=24%-76%, y=58%-69%. Everything else must be transparent: ALL sky, moon, central distant cathedral, tall architectural walls/windows/columns/banners, and ALL floor. In particular the area below y=70% is completely transparent. No bottom-border brambles or candles, those are a separate layer. Do not add any new objects or labels. Retain original gothic pixel-art shading, crimson highlights and exact silhouettes. No ground plane, no backdrop, no checkerboard drawn in the artwork. Keep the two gargoyles both present. Single full-frame landscape 16:9 output with actual alpha.
foreground: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: provided Crimson Cathedral fighting stage. Extract ONLY the closest roses, thorny black brambles, and large wax candles that form the EXTREME BOTTOM BORDER of the original stage, into one transparent full-frame 16:9 foreground layer. Preserve original alignment on the full 16:9 frame, do not crop the canvas to the objects. The top 76% of the canvas must be fully transparent. Keep only bottom-left and bottom-right decorative foreground clusters and the few low petals/branches right at the bottom edge. Leave the central 60% of the image almost completely clear so fighters remain visible. Do NOT include any stone floor, gargoyle statues, pedestals, balustrades, buildings, windows, sky or moon. No ground plane, no opaque backdrop, no text, no checkerboard painted into image. Match the original richly detailed gothic pixel art and crimson candlelit palette. Output actual alpha transparency, objects touching the bottom canvas edge, single full-frame 16:9 landscape image.
packaging: Generated PNG masters remain in the workspace output folder. Game layers resized to 1280x720 WebP, quality 92, alpha quality 100. Transparent alpha is preserved. The original stage is retained.
